candidate_windows.window_text: Our implementation is based on the Transformers library (Wolf et al., 2020) and PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2017). All our experiments were conducted using two GPUs with 11GB RAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti). Generating STS- $\mathbf{x}_1\mathbf{x}_2$ and STS- $\mathbf{x}_2$ using both GPUs took approximately 48 hours per dataset. Training a Sentence Transformer on these datasets took less than 2 hours on average.
